caption: The 248B-token model through Helico, comparing top-L with exact top-L/2 predicted contacts from the same archived 100-rollout consensus rankings. The L/2 arm filters mapped separation <6 before taking floor(L/2), so every map reaches its budget. The archived top-L arm filters after taking L; actual counts are saved. Three diffusion samples/map, highest ranking_score selection; no MSA or oracle seed contacts. *Oracle supplies two random subsets of floor(L/2) ground-truth contacts, selects one of three samples per subset, then averages subset accuracies. All other pairs stay unknown in every contact arm. Same 305 natural proteins (95 validation + 210 test), with 95% protein-bootstrap intervals. Oracle caps at 109 versus 110 requested contacts for one protein, and uses two maps rather than one. See MARINFOLD_L2.md, ORACLE_L2.md and coverage.csv. AlphaFold2/3 and Boltz-2 use the same archived MSA queries and alignments underlying these depth bins, with templates disabled and protein-chain-only inputs. Confidence selects among five AF2 pTM models (three recycles), 25 AF3 samples (five seeds, ten recycles), or 25 Boltz-2 samples (one seed, ten recycles). These are controlled shared-MSA runs, not the models’ full default search pipelines.
